summary: 81-year-old cross-country skier Robert Blake of Corrales, NM failed to return from a Friday afternoon outing near Lizard Head Pass; a Saturday morning search found his body, his Golden Retriever Buddy guarding it from coyotes.
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR / ground crews
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: blog 'Last Updated' resolves to Saturday 2014-05-31 (incident Saturday could be May 24; recorded at May 31 per same-day AP-report convention). Sheriff said Blake appeared to have died of natural causes. A Bell 407 search helicopter contracted out of Moab, UT lost power at ~10,000 ft near the pass ~noon Saturday and crashed — pilot and sheriff's deputy aboard survived uninjured; FAA/NTSB investigated.
